acceptanceCriteria: The spec records how a corrected computation of an existing sealed S0E member (e.g. citation) is carried: a recorded value re-emission with predecessor digests, a versioned profile, or an explicit refusal; owner-approved.
tools/cem-stable-regen implements the recorded path with a test that refuses an unrecorded value change.
body: Found 2026-10-15 by the V1-1331/1335/1332 citation-measure lane (WIP 23e661b62 on BASE c77d35c64, branch claude/v1-1331-1335-1332-citation-measures, darwin go1.27.2). tools/cem-stable-regen and CEM-V1-091 only allow additive member regeneration; docs/specs/cem-stable-v1.md says the frozen packet is never rewritten otherwise. Any correction to the citation computation (owner-approved CEM-V1-081/082 amendments) changes the existing `citation` member of sealed S0E results (verdictSha256 input), so it cannot land. Reproduce: apply 23e661b62, run (cd interop/cem01-go && GOTOOLCHAIN=local go test -count=1 -timeout 30m -run 'TestStableCanonicalFullResults|TestStableCanonicalEnvelopeCells' .): cases 14 and 52 and cells ordinary/origin/linked-sha1 differ first at key citation. Expected: a governed way to correct a sealed member. Actual: none. Blocks V1-1331/V1-1335.
title: cem-stable-regen has no governed path to correct an existing sealed S0E member value (blocks citation-measure fixes)
